steps.text: Peel and slice bananas crosswise into thin slices.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place the bread slices on a flat surface. Spread bread with peanut butter, top half with banana slices, then close the sandwiches with the remaining slices.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more oil to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and warmed through, 2-4 minutes more. Transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates and enjoy!
